subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — FinBank (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finbank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finbank.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro demo: Redwood Inference — FinBank (next steps)

Thanks again for your time this morning — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap:
- Goals: reduce inference latency on customer-facing workflows and get predictable unit economics for production.
- Current constraints: mixed cloud footprint, strict data isolation for PII, and 99th-percentile latency target for peak traffic.

Next step: 30-minute product demo (intro + high-level architecture) so we can validate fit and identify technical owners for a deeper pilot. I have three slots that work on our side — please pick any that fit you and your team, or suggest alternatives:
- Tue 20 Feb, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 21 Feb, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 22 Feb, 09:00–09:30 PT

Suggested attendees from your side: product owner, platform/infra lead, and a technical reviewer. From our side I'll bring a short agenda and an SE for technical Q&A. Attached is a one-page agenda (Redwood_30min-demo-agenda.pdf).

If you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite and include our SE (Rishi) and CSM (Vanessa) so we have the right folks.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
https://redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_30min-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
